title: Remote foundations M3: atomic central append, dedup and wake obligation, plus the sender intent registry (retry-only outbox)
outcome: Remote foundations M3: atomic central append, dedup and wake obligation, plus the sender intent registry (retry-only outbox)
acceptance: Sender host: one durable intent registry UNIQUE(sender_session_id, idempotency_key) across ALL targets, written before the first RPC, with distinct states localIntentDurable/appendOutcomeUnknown/homeCommitted/refused/abandoned; a queued or unknown intent is never reported as a successful send receipt, and the registry is never a source for mailbox list/read/ACK/cursor (P-5). After confirmation or terminal refusal, retry payloads may be removed while minimal key/digest/target/outcome metadata remains for idempotency.

Central host: append, dedup row UNIQUE(sender_host_id, sender_session_id, key) with canonical digest, and wake obligation commit in ONE transaction; same key + same digest returns the original identity (duplicate=true); same key + different digest or target is a 409 conflict.

Fail-first tests: crash cuts before/after local durability and before/after the central commit; lost replies; parallel same-key sends; changed content/target conflicts for local and remote targets; disk-full and bounded queues (1,000 intents / 64 MiB per peer, visible refusal); cancellation then GC then delayed first send; exactly one canonical append; authoritative outcomes survive restart.
Behind the M1 disabled-by-default setting; local behaviour unchanged.
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
